```bash
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"

import { castNumber } from "../../../lib/cast-number"
import {
  normalizePrices,
  normalizeProductFormValues,
} from "../product-create/utils"

/*
 * Bundles in the admin dashboard (issue #114).
 *
 * A bundle is a normal product with one variant, its own prices, and the list
 * of component variants in `product.metadata.bundle.components` (issue #112).
 * When an order is placed, each component's share of what was paid is saved on
 * the order line in `metadata.bundle.components`, and a return of a single
 * component names it in the return item's `metadata.bundle_component`
 * (issue #113).
 *
 * The dashboard cannot import from `@medusajs/utils` (eslint
 * `admin-no-medusa-utils-import`), so the keys and the error code are repeated
 * here. They are covered by tests on both sides.
 *
 * Everything in this file is a pure function so it can be unit tested.
 */

/** Key in `product.metadata` that marks a product as a bundle. */
export const BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY = "bundle"

/** Key in an order line's metadata holding the saved component shares. */
export const BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY = "bundle"

/** Key in a return item's metadata naming the returned component. */
export const BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY = "bundle_component"

/** Smallest number of components a bundle can have. */
export const MIN_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS = 2

/**
 * Code on the error thrown when deleting a product or variant that a bundle
 * uses. It is `MedusaError.Codes.BUNDLE_IN_USE` on the server.
 */
export const BUNDLE_IN_USE_ERROR_CODE = "bundle_in_use"

/** One component of a bundle, as the product stores it. */
export type BundleComponent = {
  variant_id: string
  quantity: number
}

/** One component of a bundle line item, as the order stores it. */
export type OrderBundleComponent = {
  variant_id: string
  title: string
  /** How many of the component are in one bundle. */
  quantity: number
  /** How many the whole line holds (line quantity x quantity). */
  units: number
  /** The component's share of what was paid for the line. */
  refund_share: number
}

type WithMetadata = { metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null }

/**
 * Reads a bundle's components from product metadata. Returns `null` when the
 * product is not a bundle.
 */
export const getBundleComponents = (
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
): BundleComponent[] | null => {
  const bundle = metadata?.[BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY] as
    | { components?: unknown }
    | undefined

  if (!bundle || !Array.isArray(bundle.components)) {
    return null
  }

  return bundle.components as BundleComponent[]
}

/** True when the product is a bundle. */
export const isBundle = (product?: WithMetadata | null): boolean =>
  getBundleComponents(product?.metadata) !== null

/**
 * True when a failed request was refused because a bundle uses the product or
 * variant. Matching the code rather than the message keeps the dashboard off
 * the wording of the error (issue #114, AC 7).
 */
export const isBundleUsageError = (error?: { code?: string } | null): boolean =>
  error?.code === BUNDLE_IN_USE_ERROR_CODE

/**
 * Finds the bundles that use any of the given variants as a component. Mirrors
 * `findBundlesUsingVariants` in core-flows, which is what blocks the delete.
 *
 * @param products - products to search (only bundles can match)
 * @param variantIds - the variants being deleted
 * @param ignoreProductIds - products being deleted in the same request, which
 *   must not block themselves
 */
export const findBundlesUsingVariants = (
  products: (WithMetadata & { id: string; title?: string | null })[],
  variantIds: string[],
  ignoreProductIds: string[] = []
): { id: string; title?: string | null }[] => {
  const targets = new Set(variantIds)
  const ignored = new Set(ignoreProductIds)

  return products
    .filter((product) => !ignored.has(product.id))
    .filter((product) =>
      (getBundleComponents(product.metadata) ?? []).some((component) =>
        targets.has(component.variant_id)
      )
    )
    .map(({ id, title }) => ({ id, title }))
}

/**
 * The values a bundle form holds. The product fields are the same ones the
 * product create form uses, so its sections can render them unchanged.
 */
export type BundleFormValues = Omit<
  Parameters<typeof normalizeProductFormValues>[0],
  "options" | "variants" | "enable_variants"
> & {
  components: { variant_id: string; quantity: number | string }[]
  prices: Record<string, number | string | undefined>
}

/**
 * Turns bundle form values into the body of `POST /admin/bundles`.
 *
 * The product fields go through the product form's own normalizer, so a bundle
 * is organised exactly like any other product. `variants` and `options` are
 * dropped because the bundle workflow creates the single variant itself and the
 * route rejects them.
 */
export const normalizeBundleFormValues = (
  values: BundleFormValues & {
    status: HttpTypes.AdminProductStatus
    regionsCurrencyMap: Record<string, string>
  }
): HttpTypes.AdminCreateBundle => {
  const {
    variants: _variants,
    options: _options,
    ...productFields
  } = normalizeProductFormValues({
    ...(values as any),
    options: [],
    variants: [],
  })

  return {
    ...productFields,
    components: values.components.map((component) => ({
      variant_id: component.variant_id,
      quantity: castNumber(component.quantity),
    })),
    prices: normalizePrices(values.prices, values.regionsCurrencyMap),
  }
}

/**
 * Reads the components saved on an order line item when the order was placed.
 * Returns `null` when the line is not a bundle.
 */
export const getOrderLineBundleComponents = (
  item: WithMetadata
): OrderBundleComponent[] | null => {
  const bundle = item.metadata?.[BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY] as
    | { components?: unknown }
    | undefined

  if (!bundle || !Array.isArray(bundle.components)) {
    return null
  }

  return bundle.components as OrderBundleComponent[]
}

type ReturnWithItems = {
  canceled_at?: string | null
  status?: string | null
  items?:
    | ({ item_id: string; quantity: number } & WithMetadata)[]
    | null
}

/**
 * How many units of each component of one bundle line item have been returned,
 * keyed by component variant ID (issue #114, AC 6).
 *
 * Only return items that name a component are counted: a whole-bundle return
 * is already shown by the line's own returned quantity. Canceled returns are
 * left out because nothing came back.
 */
export const getReturnedBundleComponentUnits = (
  returns: ReturnWithItems[],
  itemId: string
): Record<string, number> => {
  const units: Record<string, number> = {}

  for (const orderReturn of returns) {
    if (orderReturn.canceled_at || orderReturn.status === "canceled") {
      continue
    }

    for (const item of orderReturn.items ?? []) {
      if (item.item_id !== itemId) {
        continue
      }

      const component = item.metadata?.[BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY] as
        | { variant_id?: string }
        | undefined

      if (!component?.variant_id) {
        continue
      }

      units[component.variant_id] =
        (units[component.variant_id] ?? 0) + Number(item.quantity ?? 0)
    }
  }

  return units
}
```

```text
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"

import { ProductCreateSchema } from "../constants"

// The schema has several other required fields, so parsing a bare object will
// always produce errors. These tests only care about whether "handle" is one
// of them, so they look at the issues for that path rather than at whether the
// whole parse succeeded.
const handleIssues = (input: Record<string, unknown>) => {
  const result = ProductCreateSchema.safeParse(input)

  if (result.success) {
    return []
  }

  return result.error.issues.filter((issue) => issue.path[0] === "handle")
}

describe("ProductCreateSchema", () => {
  it("rejects a product with no handle", () => {
    expect(handleIssues({ title: "Winter jacket" })).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a product with an empty handle", () => {
    expect(
      handleIssues({ title: "Winter jacket", handle: "" })
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("accepts a product with a handle", () => {
    expect(
      handleIssues({ title: "Winter jacket", handle: "winter-jacket" })
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("still requires a title", () => {
    const result = ProductCreateSchema.safeParse({ handle: "winter-jacket" })

    expect(result.success).toBe(false)

    if (!result.success) {
      const titleIssues = result.error.issues.filter(
        (issue) => issue.path[0] === "title"
      )
```

```bash
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"

import { BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS, BundleSchema } from "../constants"

// A bundle that satisfies every rule, used as the starting point so each test
// changes one thing only.
const validBundle = {
  ...BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS,
  title: "Camera kit",
  handle: "camera-kit",
  components: [
    { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1 },
    { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
  ],
  prices: { usd: 899 },
}

const issuesFor = (input: Record<string, unknown>, path: string) => {
  const result = BundleSchema.safeParse(input)

  if (result.success) {
    return []
  }

  return result.error.issues.filter((issue) => issue.path.join(".") === path)
}

describe("BundleSchema", () => {
  it("accepts a bundle with two components and a price", () => {
    expect(BundleSchema.safeParse(validBundle).success).toBe(true)
  })

  // AC 3: fewer than 2 components blocks saving.
  it("rejects a bundle with one component", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        { ...validBundle, components: [validBundle.components[0]] },
        "components"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a bundle with no components", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, components: [] }, "components")
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a component with no variant picked", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "", quantity: 1 },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.variant_id"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects the same variant listed twice", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 2 },
          ],
        },
        "components.1.variant_id"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  // AC 3: a quantity of 0 or less blocks saving.
  it("rejects a quantity of 0", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 0 },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.quantity"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a negative quantity", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: -1 },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.quantity"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a quantity that is not a whole number", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1.5 },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.quantity"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects an empty quantity", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: "" },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.quantity"
      )
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("accepts a quantity typed into the input as a string", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor(
        {
          ...validBundle,
          components: [
            { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: "3" },
            { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          ],
        },
        "components.0.quantity"
      )
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  // AC 3: a missing price blocks saving. The bundle route needs at least one.
  it("rejects a bundle with no price in any currency", () => {
    expect(issuesFor({ ...validBundle, prices: {} }, "prices")).not.toHaveLength(
      0
    )
  })

  it("rejects a bundle whose only price input is blank", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, prices: { usd: "" } }, "prices")
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("accepts a bundle priced in one of several currencies", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, prices: { usd: "", eur: 849 } }, "prices")
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("rejects a negative price", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, prices: { usd: -1 } }, "prices.usd")
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it("still requires a title and a handle", () => {
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, title: "" }, "title")
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
    expect(
      issuesFor({ ...validBundle, handle: "" }, "handle")
    ).not.toHaveLength(0)
  })
})
```

```bash
cd /Users/alexgrapsas/medusa-114 && cat > packages/admin/dashboard/src/routes/products/bundle-create/constants.ts <<'EOF'
import { z } from "zod"

import { i18n } from "../../../components/utilities/i18n/i18n"
import { castNumber } from "../../../lib/cast-number"
import { MIN_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS } from "../common/bundles"
import { MediaSchema } from "../product-create/constants"

/**
 * One component of a bundle as the form holds it. The quantity is a union
 * because a number input hands back a string while the admin is typing.
 */
const BundleComponentSchema = z.object({
  variant_id: z.string().min(1, i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.component")),
  quantity: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).refine(
    (value) => {
      const quantity = castNumber(value)
      return Number.isInteger(quantity) && quantity >= 1
    },
    { message: i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.quantity") }
  ),
})

export type BundleComponentSchemaType = z.infer<typeof BundleComponentSchema>

/**
 * The bundle create and edit form.
 *
 * The product fields are the same ones `ProductCreateSchema` declares, so the
 * product form's own sections render them unchanged. What a bundle adds is
 * `components` and `prices`; what it leaves out is `options`, `variants` and
 * `enable_variants`, because the bundle workflow creates the single variant
 * itself and `POST /admin/bundles` rejects them.
 *
 * The three rules of AC 3 (fewer than 2 components, a quantity of 0 or less, a
 * missing price) are all checked here, so the form blocks saving and
 * `<Form.ErrorMessage />` shows which field is wrong.
 */
export const BundleSchema = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().min(1),
    subtitle: z.string().optional(),
    handle: z.string().min(1),
    description: z.string().optional(),
    discountable: z.boolean(),
    type_id: z.string().optional(),
    collection_id: z.string().optional(),
    shipping_profile_id: z.string().optional(),
    categories: z.array(z.string()),
    tags: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    sales_channels: z
      .array(
        z.object({
          id: z.string(),
          name: z.string(),
        })
      )
      .optional(),
    origin_country: z.string().optional(),
    material: z.string().optional(),
    width: z.string().optional(),
    length: z.string().optional(),
    height: z.string().optional(),
    weight: z.string().optional(),
    mid_code: z.string().optional(),
    hs_code: z.string().optional(),
    media: z.array(MediaSchema).optional(),
    components: z
      .array(BundleComponentSchema)
      .min(MIN_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS, i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.minComponents")),
    // Keyed by currency code, or by region ID for a region-scoped price.
    prices: z.record(z.string(), z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional()),
  })
  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    // The same variant twice is rejected by the API too; saying so here points
    // at the row that has to change.
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    data.components.forEach((component, index) => {
      if (!component.variant_id) {
        return
      }

      if (seen.has(component.variant_id)) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["components", index, "variant_id"],
          message: i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.duplicateComponent"),
        })
      }

      seen.add(component.variant_id)
    })

    const prices = Object.entries(data.prices ?? {})

    prices.forEach(([key, value]) => {
      if (value === "" || value === undefined || value === null) {
        return
      }

      const amount = castNumber(value)

      if (Number.isNaN(amount) || amount < 0) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["prices", key],
          message: i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.price"),
        })
      }
    })

    // A bundle with no price can't be bought, and the route requires one.
    const hasPrice = prices.some(
      ([, value]) => value !== "" && value !== undefined && value !== null
    )

    if (!hasPrice) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["prices"],
        message: i18n.t("products.bundles.errors.minPrices"),
      })
    }
  })

export type BundleSchemaType = z.infer<typeof BundleSchema>

/**
 * An empty component row. Two of them are shown from the start, because a
 * bundle needs at least two.
 */
export const emptyBundleComponent = (): BundleComponentSchemaType => ({
  variant_id: "",
  quantity: "",
})

export const BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS: Partial<BundleSchemaType> = {
  discountable: true,
  tags: [],
  sales_channels: [],
  media: [],
  categories: [],
  collection_id: "",
  shipping_profile_id: "",
  description: "",
  handle: "",
  height: "",
  hs_code: "",
  length: "",
  material: "",
  mid_code: "",
  origin_country: "",
  subtitle: "",
  title: "",
  type_id: "",
  weight: "",
  width: "",
  components: [emptyBundleComponent(), emptyBundleComponent()],
  prices: {},
}
EOF
```

```text
const fs = require("fs/promises")
const path = require("path")
const prettier = require("prettier")

const translationsDir = path.join(__dirname, "../../src/i18n/translations")
const enPath = path.join(translationsDir, "en.json")
const schemaPath = path.join(translationsDir, "$schema.json")

const ALL_PLURAL_FORMS = ["zero", "one", "two", "few", "many", "other"]

function getBaseKey(key) {
  for (const form of ALL_PLURAL_FORMS) {
    if (key.endsWith(`_${form}`)) {
      return key.slice(0, -(form.length + 1))
    }
  }
  return null
}

function generateSchemaFromObject(obj) {
  if (typeof obj !== "object" || obj === null) {
    return { type: typeof obj }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return {
      type: "array",
      items: generateSchemaFromObject(obj[0] || "string"),
    }
  }

  const properties = {}
  const required = []
  const localePluralBaseKeys = new Set()

  Object.entries(obj).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    const baseKey = getBaseKey(key)
    if (baseKey) {
      if (!localePluralBaseKeys.has(baseKey)) {
        localePluralBaseKeys.add(baseKey)
        ALL_PLURAL_FORMS.forEach((form) => {
          properties[`${baseKey}_${form}`] = { type: "string" }
        })
      }
      return
    }

    properties[key] = generateSchemaFromObject(value)
    required.push(key)
  })
```

```bash
import { FetchError } from "@medusajs/js-sdk"
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { useMutation, UseMutationOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query"

import { sdk } from "../../lib/client"
import { queryClient } from "../../lib/query-client"
import { productsQueryKeys, variantsQueryKeys } from "./products"

/*
 * A bundle is a product, so there is no separate bundle list or detail query:
 * the product hooks already read one (issue #114). Only the two writes need
 * their own route, because `POST /admin/bundles` takes components and prices
 * that the product routes don't accept.
 */

export const useCreateBundle = (
  options?: UseMutationOptions<
    HttpTypes.AdminProductResponse,
    FetchError,
    HttpTypes.AdminCreateBundle
  >
) => {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (payload: HttpTypes.AdminCreateBundle) =>
      sdk.admin.bundle.create(payload),
    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: productsQueryKeys.lists() })
      options?.onSuccess?.(data, variables, context)
    },
    ...options,
  })
}

export const useUpdateBundle = (
  id: string,
  options?: UseMutationOptions<
    HttpTypes.AdminProductResponse,
    FetchError,
    HttpTypes.AdminUpdateBundle
  >
) => {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (payload: HttpTypes.AdminUpdateBundle) =>
      sdk.admin.bundle.update(id, payload),
    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: productsQueryKeys.lists() })
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: productsQueryKeys.detail(id),
      })
      // The bundle's one variant holds the prices and the inventory links.
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: variantsQueryKeys.all })
      options?.onSuccess?.(data, variables, context)
    },
    ...options,
  })
}
```

```text
import { QueryKey, UseQueryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query"

export type TQueryKey<TKey, TListQuery = any, TDetailQuery = string> = {
  all: readonly [TKey]
  lists: () => readonly [...TQueryKey<TKey>["all"], "list"]
  list: (
    query?: TListQuery
  ) => readonly [...ReturnType<TQueryKey<TKey>["lists"]>, { query: TListQuery }]
  details: () => readonly [...TQueryKey<TKey>["all"], "detail"]
  detail: (
    id: TDetailQuery,
    query?: TListQuery
  ) => readonly [
    ...ReturnType<TQueryKey<TKey>["details"]>,
    TDetailQuery,
    { query: TListQuery }
  ]
}

export type UseQueryOptionsWrapper<
  // Return type of queryFn
  TQueryFn = unknown,
  // Type thrown in case the queryFn rejects
  E = Error,
  // Query key type
  TQueryKey extends QueryKey = QueryKey
> = Omit<
  UseQueryOptions<TQueryFn, E, TQueryFn, TQueryKey>,
  "queryKey" | "queryFn"
>

export const queryKeysFactory = <
  T,
  TListQueryType = any,
  TDetailQueryType = string
>(
  globalKey: T
) => {
  const queryKeyFactory: TQueryKey<T, TListQueryType, TDetailQueryType> = {
    all: [globalKey],
    lists: () => [...queryKeyFactory.all, "list"],
    list: (query?: TListQueryType) =>
      [...queryKeyFactory.lists(), query ? { query } : undefined].filter(
        (k) => !!k
      ) as unknown as readonly [T, "list", { query: TListQueryType }],
    details: () => [...queryKeyFactory.all, "detail"],
    detail: (id: TDetailQueryType, query?: TListQueryType) =>
      [...queryKeyFactory.details(), id, query ? { query } : undefined].filter(
        (k) => !!k
      ) as unknown as readonly [
        T,
        "detail",
        TDetailQueryType,
        { query: TListQueryType }
      ],
  }
  return queryKeyFactory
}
```

```text
import {
  QueryKey,
  keepPreviousData,
  useInfiniteQuery,
  useQuery,
} from "@tanstack/react-query"
import { useDebouncedSearch } from "./use-debounced-search"

type ComboboxExternalData = {
  offset: number
  limit: number
  count: number
}

type ComboboxQueryParams = {
  id?: string
  q?: string
  offset?: number
  limit?: number
}

export const useComboboxData = <
  TResponse extends ComboboxExternalData,
  TParams extends ComboboxQueryParams,
  TOption extends { label: string; value: string } = {
    label: string
    value: string
  }
>({
  queryKey,
  queryFn,
  getOptions,
  defaultValue,
  defaultValueKey,
  selectedValue,
  pageSize = 10, 
  enabled = true,
}: {
  queryKey: QueryKey
  queryFn: (params: TParams) => Promise<TResponse>
  getOptions: (data: TResponse) => TOption[]
  defaultValueKey?: keyof TParams
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
  selectedValue?: string
  pageSize?: number
  enabled?: boolean
}) => {
  const { searchValue, onSearchValueChange, query } = useDebouncedSearch()

  const queryInitialDataBy = defaultValueKey || "id"
  const { data: initialData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...queryKey, defaultValue].filter(Boolean) as QueryKey,
    queryFn: async () => {
      return queryFn({
        [queryInitialDataBy]: defaultValue,
        limit: Array.isArray(defaultValue) ? defaultValue.length : 1,
      } as TParams)
    },
    enabled: !!defaultValue && enabled,
  })

  // always load selected value in case current data dosn't contain the value
  const { data: selectedData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...queryKey, selectedValue].filter(Boolean) as QueryKey,
    queryFn: async () => {
      return queryFn({
        id: selectedValue,
        limit: 1,
      } as TParams)
    },
    enabled: !!selectedValue && enabled,
  })

  const { data, ...rest } = useInfiniteQuery({
    // prevent infinite query response shape beeing stored under regualr list reponse QKs
    queryKey: [...queryKey, "_cbx_", query].filter(Boolean) as QueryKey,
    queryFn: async ({ pageParam = 0 }) => {
      return await queryFn({
        q: query,
        limit: pageSize,
        offset: pageParam,
      } as TParams)
    },
    initialPageParam: 0,
    getNextPageParam: (lastPage) => {
      const moreItemsExist = lastPage.count > lastPage.offset + lastPage.limit
      return moreItemsExist ? lastPage.offset + lastPage.limit : undefined
    },
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    enabled: enabled,
  })

  const options = data?.pages.flatMap((page) => getOptions(page)) ?? []
  const defaultOptions = initialData ? getOptions(initialData) : []
  const selectedOptions = selectedData ? getOptions(selectedData) : []
  /**
   * If there are no options and the query is empty, then the combobox should be disabled,
   * as there is no data to search for.
   */
  const disabled =
    (!rest.isPending && !options.length && !searchValue) || !enabled

  // make sure that the default value is included in the options
  if (defaultValue && defaultOptions.length && !searchValue) {
    defaultOptions.forEach((option) => {
      if (!options.find((o) => o.value === option.value)) {
        options.unshift(option)
      }
    })
  }

  if (selectedValue && selectedOptions.length) {
    selectedOptions.forEach((option) => {
      if (!options.find((o) => o.value === option.value)) {
        options.unshift(option)
      }
    })
  }

  return {
    options,
    searchValue,
    onSearchValueChange,
    disabled,
    ...rest,
  }
}
```

```bash
import { XMarkMini } from "@medusajs/icons"
import { Button, Hint, IconButton, Input, Label } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { UseFormReturn, useFieldArray, useWatch } from "react-hook-form"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"

import { Form } from "../../../../../components/common/form"
import { Combobox } from "../../../../../components/inputs/combobox"
import { useComboboxData } from "../../../../../hooks/use-combobox-data"
import { sdk } from "../../../../../lib/client"
import {
  BundleSchemaType,
  emptyBundleComponent,
} from "../../../bundle-create/constants"

/**
 * Fields the variant picker needs to label an option.
 */
const VARIANT_FIELDS = "id,title,sku,product.title"

const variantLabel = (variant: {
  title?: string | null
  sku?: string | null
  product?: { title?: string | null } | null
}) => {
  const name = [variant.product?.title, variant.title]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ")

  return variant.sku ? `${name} (${variant.sku})` : name
}

type ComponentRowProps = {
  form: UseFormReturn<BundleSchemaType>
  index: number
  isVariantTaken: (variantId: string, index: number) => boolean
  onRemove: () => void
  canRemove: boolean
}

/**
 * One component row: which variant, and how many of it go into one bundle.
 *
 * Laid out the same way as the inventory kit rows in the product create form
 * (`ProductCreateInventoryKitSection`), which pair a combobox with a quantity
 * for the same kind of relationship.
 */
const ComponentRow = ({
  form,
  index,
  isVariantTaken,
  onRemove,
  canRemove,
}: ComponentRowProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const selectedVariantId = useWatch({
    control: form.control,
    name: `components.${index}.variant_id`,
  })

  const variants = useComboboxData({
    queryKey: ["product_variants", "bundle_components"],
    defaultValueKey: "id",
    selectedValue: selectedVariantId,
    queryFn: (params) =>
      sdk.admin.productVariant.list({ ...params, fields: VARIANT_FIELDS }),
    getOptions: (data) =>
      data.variants.map((variant) => ({
        label: variantLabel(variant),
        value: variant.id,
      })),
  })

  return (
    <li className="bg-ui-bg-component shadow-elevation-card-rest grid grid-cols-[1fr_28px] items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl p-1.5">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-[min-content,1fr] items-center gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center px-2 py-1.5">
          <Label
            size="xsmall"
            weight="plus"
            className="text-ui-fg-subtle"
            htmlFor={`components.${index}.variant_id`}
          >
            {t("fields.variant")}
          </Label>
        </div>

        <Form.Field
          control={form.control}
          name={`components.${index}.variant_id`}
          render={({ field }) => (
            <Form.Item>
              <Form.Control>
                <Combobox
                  {...field}
                  options={variants.options.map((option) => ({
                    ...option,
                    disabled: isVariantTaken(option.value, index),
                  }))}
                  searchValue={variants.searchValue}
                  onBlur={() => variants.onSearchValueChange("")}
                  onSearchValueChange={variants.onSearchValueChange}
                  fetchNextPage={variants.fetchNextPage}
                  className="bg-ui-bg-field-component hover:bg-ui-bg-field-component-hover"
                  placeholder={t(
                    "products.bundles.components.variantPlaceholder"
                  )}
                />
              </Form.Control>
              <Form.ErrorMessage />
            </Form.Item>
          )}
        />

        <div className="flex items-center px-2 py-1.5">
          <Label
            size="xsmall"
            weight="plus"
            className="text-ui-fg-subtle"
            htmlFor={`components.${index}.quantity`}
          >
            {t("fields.quantity")}
          </Label>
        </div>
        <Form.Field
          control={form.control}
          name={`components.${index}.quantity`}
          render={({ field: { onChange, value, ...field } }) => (
            <Form.Item>
              <Form.Control>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  className="bg-ui-bg-field-component"
                  min={1}
                  step={1}
                  value={value ?? ""}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const next = event.target.value
                    onChange(next === "" ? "" : Number(next))
                  }}
                  {...field}
                  placeholder={t(
                    "products.bundles.components.quantityPlaceholder"
                  )}
                />
              </Form.Control>
              <Form.ErrorMessage />
            </Form.Item>
          )}
        />
      </div>
      {canRemove ? (
        <IconButton
          type="button"
          size="small"
          variant="transparent"
          className="text-ui-fg-muted"
          aria-label={t("actions.remove")}
          onClick={onRemove}
        >
          <XMarkMini />
        </IconButton>
      ) : (
        <span />
      )}
    </li>
  )
}

type BundleComponentsFormProps = {
  form: UseFormReturn<BundleSchemaType>
}

/**
 * The components section of the bundle create and edit forms (AC 1 and 2).
 *
 * The "at least 2 components" message belongs to the array rather than to any
 * one row, so it is read off form state and rendered under the list.
 */
export const BundleComponentsForm = ({ form }: BundleComponentsFormProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const components = useFieldArray({
    control: form.control,
    name: "components",
  })

  const values = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: "components" })

  /**
   * A variant already used by another row is disabled, which is the same way
   * the inventory kit rows keep one item out of two rows.
   */
  const isVariantTaken = (variantId: string, index: number) =>
    !!values?.some(
      (component, otherIndex) =>
        otherIndex !== index && component.variant_id === variantId
    )

  const arrayError = form.formState.errors.components

  return (
    <div id="components" className="flex flex-col gap-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-x-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <Form.Label>{t("products.bundles.components.label")}</Form.Label>
          <Form.Hint>{t("products.bundles.components.hint")}</Form.Hint>
        </div>
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="secondary"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => components.append(emptyBundleComponent())}
        >
          {t("products.bundles.components.add")}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-y-2">
        {components.fields.map((field, index) => (
          <ComponentRow
            key={field.id}
            form={form}
            index={index}
            isVariantTaken={isVariantTaken}
            onRemove={() => components.remove(index)}
            canRemove={components.fields.length > 1}
          />
        ))}
      </ul>

      {/*
        `arrayError` is the array itself when the list is too short, and an
        array of per-row errors otherwise, so only a message on the node is
        shown here. The rows render their own.
      */}
      {arrayError && "message" in arrayError && arrayError.message && (
        <Hint variant="error">{String(arrayError.message)}</Hint>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```bash
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { CurrencyInput, Hint } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"

import { Form } from "../../../../../components/common/form"
import { getCurrencySymbol } from "../../../../../lib/data/currencies"
import { BundleSchemaType } from "../../../bundle-create/constants"

type BundlePricesFormProps = {
  form: UseFormReturn<BundleSchemaType>
  currencies: HttpTypes.AdminStore["supported_currencies"]
}

/**
 * The bundle's own price, one input per currency the store supports (AC 1).
 *
 * The product form prices many variants at once in a data grid; a bundle has a
 * single variant, so the same `prices` record is edited as a short list of
 * inputs keyed by currency code. `normalizePrices` turns it into the payload
 * for both forms.
 */
export const BundlePricesForm = ({
  form,
  currencies = [],
}: BundlePricesFormProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  // "Set a price in at least one currency" belongs to the record, not to any
  // one currency input, so it is read off form state and shown under the list.
  const pricesError = form.formState.errors.prices

  return (
    <div id="prices" className="flex flex-col gap-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <Form.Label>{t("products.bundles.prices.label")}</Form.Label>
        <Form.Hint>{t("products.bundles.prices.hint")}</Form.Hint>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {currencies.map(({ currency_code }) => (
          <Form.Field
            key={currency_code}
            control={form.control}
            name={`prices.${currency_code}`}
            render={({ field: { onChange, value, ...field } }) => (
              <Form.Item>
                <Form.Label>{currency_code.toUpperCase()}</Form.Label>
                <Form.Control>
                  <CurrencyInput
                    {...field}
                    min={0}
                    code={currency_code}
                    symbol={getCurrencySymbol(currency_code)}
                    value={value ?? ""}
                    onValueChange={(amount) => onChange(amount ?? "")}
                  />
                </Form.Control>
                <Form.ErrorMessage />
              </Form.Item>
            )}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {pricesError && "message" in pricesError && pricesError.message && (
        <Hint variant="error">{String(pricesError.message)}</Hint>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
EOF
```

```bash
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { Alert, Divider, Heading, Text } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form"

import { StackedFocusModal } from "../../../../../components/modals"
import { ProductCreateSchemaType } from "../../../product-create/types"
import { ProductCreateMediaSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-details-form/components/product-create-details-media-section"
import { ProductCreateGeneralSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-details-form/components/product-create-details-general-section"
import { ProductCreateOrganizationSection } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-organize-form/components/product-create-organize-section"
import { ProductCreateSalesChannelStackedModal } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-organize-form/components/product-create-sales-channel-stacked-modal"
import { SC_STACKED_MODAL_ID } from "../../../product-create/components/product-create-organize-form/constants"
import { BundleSchemaType } from "../../../bundle-create/constants"
import { BundleComponentsForm } from "../bundle-components-form"
import { BundlePricesForm } from "../bundle-prices-form"

/*
 * The bundle's product fields are the product form's own fields, under the same
 * names, so its sections render them with no changes: the general section
 * (title, subtitle, handle, description), the media section (images and the
 * thumbnail) and the organization section (categories, collection, type, tags,
 * sales channels, shipping profile). What a bundle adds on top is the component
 * list and its own price.
 *
 * Those sections are typed against `ProductCreateSchemaType`. `BundleSchema`
 * declares the same fields for everything they touch and leaves out only
 * `options`, `variants` and `enable_variants`, which none of them read, so the
 * form is passed through with a cast rather than duplicating the fields.
 */
const asProductForm = (form: UseFormReturn<BundleSchemaType>) =>
  form as unknown as UseFormReturn<ProductCreateSchemaType>

type BundleFormFieldsProps = {
  form: UseFormReturn<BundleSchemaType>
  currencies: HttpTypes.AdminStore["supported_currencies"]
  /** Heading shown above the form. */
  header: string
  /** One line under the heading. */
  hint: string
  /**
   * The message from a rejected save. It is shown here, above the fields the
   * admin filled in, which are left exactly as they were typed (AC 4).
   */
  serverError?: string | null
}

export const BundleFormFields = ({
  form,
  currencies,
  header,
  hint,
  serverError,
}: BundleFormFieldsProps) => {
  const productForm = asProductForm(form)

  return (
    <StackedFocusModal id={SC_STACKED_MODAL_ID}>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center p-16">
        <div className="flex w-full max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-y-8">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-1">
            <Heading>{header}</Heading>
            <Text size="small" className="text-ui-fg-subtle">
              {hint}
            </Text>
          </div>

          {serverError && (
            <Alert variant="error" dismissible={false}>
              {serverError}
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-6">
            <ProductCreateGeneralSection form={productForm} />
            <ProductCreateMediaSection form={productForm} />
          </div>

          <Divider />
          <BundleComponentsForm form={form} />

          <Divider />
          <BundlePricesForm form={form} currencies={currencies} />

          <Divider />
          <ProductCreateOrganizationSection form={productForm} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <ProductCreateSalesChannelStackedModal form={productForm} />
    </StackedFocusModal>
  )
}
```

```text
      }

    },
```

```bash
class MockIntersectionObserver {
  observe = vi.fn()
  disconnect = vi.fn()
  unobserve = vi.fn()
}

Object.defineProperty(window, "IntersectionObserver", {
  writable: true,
  configurable: true,
  value: MockIntersectionObserver,
})

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup()
})

const onValid = vi.fn()

/**
 * The components and price sections of the bundle form, wired to the same
 * schema and resolver the real form uses, so a submit runs the real
 * validation and the messages come from the real schema.
 */
const Harness = ({ values }: { values?: Partial<BundleSchemaType> }) => {
  const form = useForm<BundleSchemaType>({
    defaultValues: {
      ...BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS,
      title: "Camera kit",
      handle: "camera-kit",
      ...values,
    } as BundleSchemaType,
    resolver: zodFormResolver(BundleSchema),
  })

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit((data) => onValid(data))}>
        <BundleComponentsForm form={form} />
        <BundlePricesForm
          form={form}
          currencies={[{ currency_code: "usd" } as any]}
        />
        <button type="submit">Save</button>
      </form>
    </Form>
  )
}

const renderHarness = (values?: Partial<BundleSchemaType>) => {
  onValid.mockReset()

  render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={new QueryClient()}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <Harness values={values} />
      </TooltipProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  )
}

const save = async () => {
  const user = userEvent.setup()
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }))
}

const twoComponents = [
  { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1 },
  { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 2 },
]

describe("bundle form validation (AC 3)", () => {
  it("lets a bundle with two components and a price through", async () => {
    renderHarness({ components: twoComponents, prices: { usd: 899 } })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() => expect(onValid).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    expect(onValid.mock.calls[0][0].components).toEqual(twoComponents)
  })

  it("shows the minimum-components message and blocks saving", async () => {
    renderHarness({
      components: [twoComponents[0]],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText("A bundle needs at least 2 components.")
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )
    expect(onValid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it("shows a message on the row whose variant is not picked", async () => {
    renderHarness({
      components: [{ variant_id: "", quantity: 1 }, twoComponents[1]],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText("Pick a variant.")).toBeTruthy())
    expect(onValid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it("shows a message on the row whose quantity is 0 and blocks saving", async () => {
    renderHarness({
      components: [{ variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 0 }, twoComponents[1]],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText("Quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.")
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )
    expect(onValid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it("shows a message when a quantity is left empty", async () => {
    renderHarness({
      components: [{ variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: "" }, twoComponents[1]],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText("Quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.")
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )
    expect(onValid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it("shows the missing-price message and blocks saving", async () => {
    renderHarness({ components: twoComponents, prices: {} })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText("Set a price in at least one currency.")
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )
    expect(onValid).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it("shows a message when the same variant is a component twice", async () => {
    renderHarness({
      components: [
        { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
        { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
      ],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText(

        )
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )

  })

  it("clears the message once the quantity is corrected", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderHarness({
      components: [{ variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 0 }, twoComponents[1]],
      prices: { usd: 899 },
    })

    await save()

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText("Quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.")
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )

    const quantities = screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")
    await user.clear(quantities[0])
    await user.type(quantities[0], "2")
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(onValid).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    expect(
      screen.queryByText("Quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.")
    ).toBeNull()
  })

  it("adds and removes component rows", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderHarness({ components: twoComponents, prices: { usd: 899 } })

    expect(screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")).toHaveLength(2)

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add component" }))
    expect(screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")).toHaveLength(3)

    await user.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Remove" })[2])
    expect(screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")).toHaveLength(2)
  })
})
```

```text
import i18n from "i18next"
import LanguageDetector from "i18next-browser-languagedetector"
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next"

import { defaultI18nOptions } from "../../../i18n/config"
import { useExtension } from "../../../providers/extension-provider"

export const I18n = () => {
  const { getI18nResources } = useExtension()

  if (i18n.isInitialized) {
    return null
  }

  const resources = getI18nResources()
  i18n
    .use(
      new LanguageDetector(null, {
        lookupCookie: "lng",
        lookupLocalStorage: "lng",
      })
    )
    .use(initReactI18next)
    .init({
      ...defaultI18nOptions,
      resources,
      supportedLngs: Object.keys(resources),
    })

  return null
}
```

```bash
import { AdminFile, HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { Button, toast } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"

import {
  RouteFocusModal,
  useRouteModal,
} from "../../../../../components/modals"
import { KeyboundForm } from "../../../../../components/utilities/keybound-form"
import { useCreateBundle } from "../../../../../hooks/api/bundles"
import { sdk } from "../../../../../lib/client"
import { zodFormResolver } from "../../../../../lib/zod-form-resolver"
import { normalizeBundleFormValues } from "../../../common/bundles"
import { BundleFormFields } from "../../../common/components/bundle-form-fields"
import { BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS, BundleSchema, BundleSchemaType } from "../../constants"

const SAVE_DRAFT_BUTTON = "save-draft-button"

type BundleCreateFormProps = {
  store: HttpTypes.AdminStore
  regions: HttpTypes.AdminRegion[]
  defaultChannel?: HttpTypes.AdminSalesChannel
}

/**
 * Creates a bundle through `POST /admin/bundles` (issue #114, AC 1).
 *
 * The form is one page rather than the product form's wizard: a bundle has no
 * options or variants to build up, so there is nothing to step through.
 */
export const BundleCreateForm = ({
  store,
  regions,
  defaultChannel,
}: BundleCreateFormProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { handleSuccess } = useRouteModal()

  /**
   * The message from a rejected save, shown above the form. Keeping it in state
   * rather than in a toast means the admin can read it next to the fields they
   * filled in, which are left as they were typed (AC 4).
   */
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const form = useForm<BundleSchemaType>({
    defaultValues: {
      ...BUNDLE_CREATE_FORM_DEFAULTS,
      sales_channels: defaultChannel
        ? [{ id: defaultChannel.id, name: defaultChannel.name }]
        : [],
    } as BundleSchemaType,
    resolver: zodFormResolver(BundleSchema),
  })

  const { mutateAsync, isPending } = useCreateBundle()

  const regionsCurrencyMap = useMemo(
    () =>
      (regions ?? []).reduce((acc, region) => {
        acc[region.id] = region.currency_code
        return acc
      }, {} as Record<string, string>),
    [regions]
  )

  const handleSubmit = form.handleSubmit(async (values, event) => {
    let isDraft = false
    if (event?.nativeEvent instanceof SubmitEvent) {
      const submitter = event.nativeEvent.submitter as HTMLButtonElement | null
      isDraft = submitter?.dataset.name === SAVE_DRAFT_BUTTON
    }

    setServerError(null)

    const media = values.media || []
    let uploaded: { url: string; isThumbnail: boolean }[] = []

    try {
      if (media.length) {
        const thumbnail = media.find((m) => m.isThumbnail)
        const others = media.filter((m) => !m.isThumbnail)

        const requests: Promise<(AdminFile & { isThumbnail: boolean })[]>[] = []

        if (thumbnail) {
          requests.push(
            sdk.admin.upload
              .create({ files: [thumbnail.file] })
              .then((r) => r.files.map((f) => ({ ...f, isThumbnail: true })))
          )
        }

        if (others.length) {
          requests.push(
            sdk.admin.upload
              .create({ files: others.map((m) => m.file) })
              .then((r) => r.files.map((f) => ({ ...f, isThumbnail: false })))
          )
        }

        uploaded = (await Promise.all(requests)).flat()
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(error.message)
      }
      return
    }

    const payload = normalizeBundleFormValues({
      ...values,
      media: uploaded as BundleSchemaType["media"],
      status: (isDraft ? "draft" : "published") as HttpTypes.AdminProductStatus,
      regionsCurrencyMap,
    })

    try {
      const { product } = await mutateAsync(payload)

      toast.success(
        t("products.bundles.createSuccessToast", { title: product.title })
      )

      handleSuccess(`/products/${product.id}`)
    } catch (error) {
      // The workflow rejects a bundle the form cannot check on its own: a
      // component that is itself a bundle, one that does not track inventory,
      // a variant that no longer exists (AC 4).
      setServerError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? "")
      )
    }
  })

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal.Form form={form}>
      <KeyboundForm onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex h-full flex-col">
        <RouteFocusModal.Header />
        <RouteFocusModal.Body className="size-full overflow-y-auto">
          <BundleFormFields
            form={form}
            currencies={store.supported_currencies}
            header={t("products.bundles.createHeader")}
            hint={t("products.bundles.createHint")}
            serverError={serverError}
          />
        </RouteFocusModal.Body>
        <RouteFocusModal.Footer>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-x-2">
            <RouteFocusModal.Close asChild>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="small">
                {t("actions.cancel")}
              </Button>
            </RouteFocusModal.Close>
            <Button
              data-name={SAVE_DRAFT_BUTTON}
              size="small"
              type="submit"
              isLoading={isPending}
              className="whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              {t("actions.saveAsDraft")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              data-name="publish-button"
              size="small"
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              isLoading={isPending}
            >
              {t("actions.publish")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </RouteFocusModal.Footer>
      </KeyboundForm>
    </RouteFocusModal.Form>
  )
}
EOF
```

```bash
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"

import { RouteFocusModal } from "../../../components/modals"
import { useRegions } from "../../../hooks/api"
import { useSalesChannel } from "../../../hooks/api/sales-channels"
import { useStore } from "../../../hooks/api/store"
import { BundleCreateForm } from "./components/bundle-create-form"

/**
 * The "Create bundle" screen, opened from the Products list.
 *
 * It loads the same context the product create screen does: the store for its
 * currencies, its default sales channel, and the regions, which a price can be
 * scoped to.
 */
export const BundleCreate = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const {
    store,
    isPending: isStorePending,
    isError: isStoreError,
    error: storeError,
  } = useStore({ fields: "+default_sales_channel" })

  const {
    sales_channel,
    isPending: isSalesChannelPending,
    isError: isSalesChannelError,
    error: salesChannelError,
  } = useSalesChannel(store?.default_sales_channel_id!, {
    enabled: !!store?.default_sales_channel_id,
  })

  const {
    regions,
    isPending: isRegionsPending,
    isError: isRegionsError,
    error: regionsError,
  } = useRegions({ limit: 9999 })

  if (isStoreError) {
    throw storeError
  }

  if (isRegionsError) {
    throw regionsError
  }

  if (isSalesChannelError) {
    throw salesChannelError
  }

  const ready =
    !!store &&
    !isStorePending &&
    !!regions &&
    !isRegionsPending &&
    !isSalesChannelPending

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal>
      <RouteFocusModal.Title asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.bundles.createHeader")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Title>
      <RouteFocusModal.Description asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.bundles.createHint")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Description>
      {ready && (
        <BundleCreateForm
          store={store}
          regions={regions}
          defaultChannel={sales_channel}
        />
      )}
    </RouteFocusModal>
  )
}
```

```bash
/**

 * components with quantities, and a price.

const fillValidBundle = async () => {
  const user = userEvent.setup()

  await user.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Title" }), "Camera kit")
  await user.type(
    screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Handle" }),

  await user.click(pickers[0])

  await user.click(pickers[1])
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("option", { name: "Lens" }))

  const quantities = screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")
  await user.type(quantities[0], "1")
  await user.type(quantities[1], "2")

  await user.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "USD" }), "899")

  return user
}

describe("BundleCreateForm", () => {
  // AC 1: an admin can create a bundle from the product fields, the variants
  // they pick with quantities, and a price.
  it("sends the product fields, the components and the price", async () => {

        title: "Camera kit",
        handle: "camera-kit",
        status: "published",
        components: [
          { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1 },
          { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 2 },
        ],
        prices: [{ currency_code: "usd", amount: 899 }],
      })
    )
  })

  it("saves a bundle as a draft from the same form", async () => {
    mutateAsync.mockResolvedValue({
      product: { id: "prod_kit", title: "Camera kit" },
    })

    renderForm()
    const user = await fillValidBundle()

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save as draft" }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(mutateAsync).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    expect(mutateAsync.mock.calls[0][0].status).toEqual("draft")
  })

  // AC 3: the form blocks saving and says what is wrong, without a request.
  it("does not send anything when the bundle is incomplete", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup()
    renderForm()

    await user.type(
      screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Title" }),
      "Camera kit"
    )
    await user.type(
      screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Handle" }),
      "camera-kit"
    )
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Publish" }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText("Pick a variant.")).toBeTruthy())
    expect(screen.getByText("Set a price in at least one currency.")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(mutateAsync).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  // AC 4: a server error is shown, and what the admin typed is still there.
  it("shows a rejected save and keeps what was entered", async () => {
    mutateAsync.mockRejectedValue(
      new Error(
        "Variant variant_lens can't be a bundle component because it belongs to a bundle."
      )
    )

    renderForm()
    const user = await fillValidBundle()

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Publish" }))

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        screen.getByText(
          "Variant variant_lens can't be a bundle component because it belongs to a bundle."
        )
      ).toBeTruthy()
    )

    expect(
      (screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Title" }) as HTMLInputElement).value
    ).toEqual("Camera kit")
    expect(
      (screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Handle" }) as HTMLInputElement)
        .value
    ).toEqual("camera-kit")
    expect(screen.getAllByPlaceholderText("How many")[1]).toHaveProperty(
      "value",
      "2"
    )
  })
})
```

```text
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { castNumber } from "../../../lib/cast-number"
import { transformNullableFormNumber } from "../../../lib/form-helpers"
import { ProductCreateSchemaType } from "../product-create/types"
import { normalizeVariants } from "../product-create/utils"

/**
 * Helpers for the full "Edit Product" flow.
 *
 * The edit flow deliberately re-uses the create flow's form schema
 * (`ProductCreateSchema`) and its tab components. That means everything in this
 * file is about translating between two shapes:
 *
 *   product returned by the API  --mapProductToFormValues-->  form values
 *   form values                  --buildProductEditRequests-->  API payloads
 *
 * All functions here are pure (no network, no React), which keeps them easy to
 * unit test and to review.
 */

/**
 * The fields we ask the API for when loading the product into the edit form.
 * The default product detail query omits several relations (variants, options,
 * images, ...) so we list everything the form needs explicitly.
 */
export const PRODUCT_EDIT_FULL_FIELDS = [
  "*variants",
  "*variants.prices",
  "*variants.options",
  "*variants.inventory_items",
  "*options",
  "*options.values",
  "*images",
  "*tags",
  "*categories",
  "*sales_channels",
  "*shipping_profile",
  "*type",
  "*collection",
].join(",")

/**
 * The API can return extra fields that the generated `HttpTypes` don't declare
 * (price rules, option ids on option values, inventory kit rows). This type
 * describes just the extras we read, so we avoid scattering `any` casts.
 */
type EditableVariant = Omit<
  HttpTypes.AdminProductVariant,
  "prices" | "inventory_items" | "options"
> & {
  prices?: {
    id: string
    currency_code: string
    amount: number
    rules?: Record<string, string>
  }[]
  inventory_items?: {
    inventory_item_id: string
    required_quantity: number
  }[]
  options?: {
    id: string
    value: string
    option_id?: string
    option?: { title?: string }
  }[]
}

type EditableProduct = Omit<HttpTypes.AdminProduct, "variants"> & {
  variants?: EditableVariant[] | null
  shipping_profile?: { id: string } | null
}

/**
 * The public `AdminProduct` type does not declare the extras above, so the
 * exported helpers accept `AdminProduct` and widen it once, here.
 */
const asEditable = (product: HttpTypes.AdminProduct) =>
  product as unknown as EditableProduct

/**
 * Variants in the form are identified only by their position (zod strips the
 * `id` because the create schema has no such field). Both the mapping into the
 * form and the diffing on save therefore go through this one function so the
 * order is guaranteed to be identical in both directions.
 */
export const getSortedVariants = (input: HttpTypes.AdminProduct) =>
  [...(asEditable(input).variants ?? [])].sort(
    (a, b) => (a.variant_rank ?? 0) - (b.variant_rank ?? 0)
  )

/**
 * Builds the form's `media` array from the product's images and thumbnail.
 * This mirrors `getDefaultValues` in the media edit form: the product stores
 * the thumbnail as a plain URL, so we flag the matching image, and if the
 * thumbnail is not among the images we add it as an extra entry.
 */
const getMediaDefaults = (product: EditableProduct) => {
  const media: ProductCreateSchemaType["media"] = (product.images ?? []).map(
    (image) => ({
      id: image.id,
      url: image.url,
      isThumbnail: image.url === product.thumbnail,
      file: null, // null means "already uploaded"; only new files carry a File
    })
  )

  if (
    product.thumbnail &&
    !media.some((item) => item.url === product.thumbnail)
  ) {
    media.unshift({
      url: product.thumbnail,
      isThumbnail: true,
      file: null,
    })
  }

  return media
}
```

```text
/**
 * Maps one stored variant to one entry of the form's `variants` array.
 * Exported separately so `buildProductEditRequests` can recompute the
 * "initial" value of a variant and detect whether the user changed it.
 */
export const mapVariantToFormValue = (
  variant: EditableVariant,
  optionTitlesById: Record<string, string>
): ProductCreateSchemaType["variants"][number] => {
  // The form keys a variant's option values by option *title*.
  const options = (variant.options ?? []).reduce((acc, optionValue) => {
    const title =
      optionValue.option?.title ??
      (optionValue.option_id ? optionTitlesById[optionValue.option_id] : "")

    if (title) {
      acc[title] = optionValue.value
    }
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, string>)

  // Prices are keyed by region id (region prices) or currency code (plain
  // prices); this is the same convention the price editor uses.
  const prices = (variant.prices ?? []).reduce((acc, price) => {
    const key = price.rules?.region_id ?? price.currency_code
    acc[key] = String(price.amount)
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, string>)

  const kitItems = variant.inventory_items ?? []

  // A variant is treated as an "inventory kit" when it maps to more than one
  // inventory item, or to a single item that needs more than one unit.
  const isKit =
    kitItems.length > 1 ||
    (kitItems.length === 1 && kitItems[0].required_quantity !== 1)

  return {
    // Identity of the saved variant. The edit flow matches rows to stored
    // variants by this, never by position, because variants can now be added,
    // removed and reordered.
    variant_id: variant.id,
    should_create: true, // every existing variant stays visible in the grid
    title: variant.title ?? "",
    sku: variant.sku ?? "",
    manage_inventory: !!variant.manage_inventory,
    allow_backorder: !!variant.allow_backorder,
    inventory_kit: isKit,
    options,
    variant_rank: variant.variant_rank ?? 0,
    prices,
    inventory: kitItems.length
      ? kitItems.map((item) => ({
          inventory_item_id: item.inventory_item_id,
          required_quantity: String(item.required_quantity),
        }))
      : [{ inventory_item_id: "", required_quantity: "" }],
  }
}
```

```bash
import { AdminFile, HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { Button, toast } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"

import {
  RouteFocusModal,
  useRouteModal,
} from "../../../../../components/modals"
import { KeyboundForm } from "../../../../../components/utilities/keybound-form"
import { useUpdateBundle } from "../../../../../hooks/api/bundles"
import { sdk } from "../../../../../lib/client"
import { zodFormResolver } from "../../../../../lib/zod-form-resolver"
import {
  mapBundleToFormValues,
  normalizeBundleFormValues,
} from "../../../common/bundles"
import { BundleFormFields } from "../../../common/components/bundle-form-fields"
import { BundleSchema, BundleSchemaType } from "../../../bundle-create/constants"

type BundleEditFormProps = {
  product: HttpTypes.AdminProduct
  store: HttpTypes.AdminStore
  regions: HttpTypes.AdminRegion[]
}

/**
 * Edits a bundle's product fields, components, quantities and price through
 * `POST /admin/bundles/:id` (issue #114, AC 2).
 *
 * It is the create form with the values filled in, which keeps one set of
 * fields and one set of rules for both.
 */
export const BundleEditForm = ({
  product,
  store,
  regions,
}: BundleEditFormProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { handleSuccess } = useRouteModal()

  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const form = useForm<BundleSchemaType>({
    defaultValues: mapBundleToFormValues(product) as BundleSchemaType,
    resolver: zodFormResolver(BundleSchema),
  })

  const { mutateAsync, isPending } = useUpdateBundle(product.id)

  const regionsCurrencyMap = useMemo(
    () =>
      (regions ?? []).reduce((acc, region) => {
        acc[region.id] = region.currency_code
        return acc
      }, {} as Record<string, string>),
    [regions]
  )

  const handleSubmit = form.handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    setServerError(null)

    // Images already on the product come back with `file: null`; only the ones
    // the admin just added carry a File and have to be uploaded first.
    const media = values.media || []
    const existing = media.filter((item) => !item.file)
    const added = media.filter((item) => item.file)

    let uploaded: { url: string; isThumbnail: boolean }[] = []

    try {
      if (added.length) {
        const thumbnail = added.find((item) => item.isThumbnail)
        const others = added.filter((item) => !item.isThumbnail)

        const requests: Promise<(AdminFile & { isThumbnail: boolean })[]>[] = []

        if (thumbnail) {
          requests.push(
            sdk.admin.upload
              .create({ files: [thumbnail.file] })
              .then((r) => r.files.map((f) => ({ ...f, isThumbnail: true })))
          )
        }

        if (others.length) {
          requests.push(
            sdk.admin.upload
              .create({ files: others.map((item) => item.file) })
              .then((r) => r.files.map((f) => ({ ...f, isThumbnail: false })))
          )
        }

        uploaded = (await Promise.all(requests)).flat()
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(error.message)
      }
      return
    }

    const payload = normalizeBundleFormValues({
      ...values,
      media: [
        ...existing.map((item) => ({
          url: item.url,
          isThumbnail: item.isThumbnail,
          file: null,
        })),
        ...uploaded,
      ] as BundleSchemaType["media"],
      // Editing a bundle does not publish or unpublish it.
      status: product.status,
      regionsCurrencyMap,
    })

    try {
      await mutateAsync(payload)

      toast.success(
        t("products.bundles.editSuccessToast", { title: payload.title })
      )

      handleSuccess(`/products/${product.id}`)
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? "")
      )
    }
  })

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal.Form form={form}>
      <KeyboundForm onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex h-full flex-col">
        <RouteFocusModal.Header />
        <RouteFocusModal.Body className="size-full overflow-y-auto">
          <BundleFormFields
            form={form}
            currencies={store.supported_currencies}
            header={t("products.bundles.editHeader")}
            hint={t("products.bundles.editHint")}
            serverError={serverError}
          />
        </RouteFocusModal.Body>
        <RouteFocusModal.Footer>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-x-2">
            <RouteFocusModal.Close asChild>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="small">
                {t("actions.cancel")}
              </Button>
            </RouteFocusModal.Close>
            <Button
              size="small"
              type="submit"
              variant="primary"
              isLoading={isPending}
            >
              {t("actions.save")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </RouteFocusModal.Footer>
      </KeyboundForm>
    </RouteFocusModal.Form>
  )
}
EOF

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom"

import { RouteFocusModal } from "../../../components/modals"
import { useRegions } from "../../../hooks/api"
import { useProduct } from "../../../hooks/api/products"
import { useStore } from "../../../hooks/api/store"
import { BUNDLE_EDIT_FIELDS } from "../common/bundles"
import { BundleEditForm } from "./components/bundle-edit-form"

/**
 * The "Edit bundle" screen, opened from a bundle's product page.
 */
export const BundleEdit = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()
  const { id } = useParams()

  const {
    product,
    isPending: isProductPending,
    isError: isProductError,
    error: productError,
  } = useProduct(id!, { fields: BUNDLE_EDIT_FIELDS })

  const {
    store,
    isPending: isStorePending,
    isError: isStoreError,
    error: storeError,
  } = useStore()

  const {
    regions,
    isPending: isRegionsPending,
    isError: isRegionsError,
    error: regionsError,
  } = useRegions({ limit: 9999 })

  if (isProductError) {
    throw productError
  }

  if (isStoreError) {
    throw storeError
  }

  if (isRegionsError) {
    throw regionsError
  }

  const ready =
    !!product &&
    !isProductPending &&
    !!store &&
    !isStorePending &&
    !!regions &&
    !isRegionsPending

  return (
    <RouteFocusModal>
      <RouteFocusModal.Title asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.bundles.editHeader")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Title>
      <RouteFocusModal.Description asChild>
        <span className="sr-only">{t("products.bundles.editHint")}</span>
      </RouteFocusModal.Description>
      {ready && (
        <BundleEditForm product={product} store={store} regions={regions} />
      )}
    </RouteFocusModal>
  )
}
```

```bash
// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { cleanup, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react"
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router-dom"
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest"

// The SDK client reads these bare globals at module load time (see
// edit-product-form.spec.tsx); Vite injects them in the real app.
vi.hoisted(() => {
  const g = global as any
  g.__BACKEND_URL__ = "http://localhost:9000"
  g.__AUTH_TYPE__ = "session"
  g.__JWT_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY__ = ""
})

import { ProductBundleSection } from "./product-bundle-section"

const variants = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  value: [] as any[],
}))

vi.mock("../../../../../hooks/api/product-variants", () => ({
  useVariants: () => ({ variants: variants.value, isPending: false }),
}))

vi.mock("react-i18next", () => ({
  useTranslation: () => ({
    t: (key: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const labels: Record<string, string> = {
        "products.bundles.section.header": "Bundle components",
        "products.bundles.section.hint": "The variants this bundle is made of.",
      }

      if (key === "products.bundles.section.quantity") {
        return `${options?.count}x`
      }

      if (key === "products.bundles.section.unknownVariant") {
        return `Variant ${options?.id}`
      }

      return labels[key] ?? key
    },
  }),
}))

vi.mock("@medusajs/icons", () => ({
  InformationCircleSolid: () => <div />,
  PencilSquare: () => <div />,
}))

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup()
  variants.value = []
})

const cameraKit = {
  id: "prod_kit",
  title: "Camera kit",
  metadata: {
    bundle: {
      components: [
        { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1 },
        { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 2 },
      ],
    },
  },
} as unknown as HttpTypes.AdminProduct

const renderSection = (product: HttpTypes.AdminProduct) =>
  render(
    <MemoryRouter>
      <ProductBundleSection product={product} />
    </MemoryRouter>
  )

describe("ProductBundleSection (AC 5)", () => {
  it("lists each component with its quantity", () => {
    variants.value = [
      {
        id: "variant_camera",
        title: "Body",
        product_id: "prod_camera",
        product: { id: "prod_camera", title: "Camera" },
      },
      {
        id: "variant_lens",
        title: "50mm",
        product_id: "prod_lens",
        product: { id: "prod_lens", title: "Lens" },
      },
    ]

    renderSection(cameraKit)

    expect(screen.getByText("Camera · Body")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByText("Lens · 50mm")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByText("1x")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByText("2x")).toBeTruthy()
  })

  it("links each component to its own product page", () => {
    variants.value = [
      {
        id: "variant_camera",
        title: "Body",
        product_id: "prod_camera",
        product: { id: "prod_camera", title: "Camera" },
      },
      {
        id: "variant_lens",
        title: "50mm",
        product_id: "prod_lens",
        product: { id: "prod_lens", title: "Lens" },
      },
    ]

    renderSection(cameraKit)

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Camera · Body" }).getAttribute("href")
    ).toEqual("/products/prod_camera")
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Lens · 50mm" }).getAttribute("href")
    ).toEqual("/products/prod_lens")
  })

  it("keeps the component listed when its variant cannot be read", () => {
    // A component whose product was removed from the admin's view still has to
    // be visible, otherwise the bundle looks like it has fewer parts than it
    // does.
    variants.value = [
      {
        id: "variant_camera",
        title: "Body",
        product_id: "prod_camera",
        product: { id: "prod_camera", title: "Camera" },
      },
    ]

    renderSection(cameraKit)

    expect(screen.getByText("Camera · Body")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByText("Variant variant_lens")).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.queryByRole("link", { name: "Variant variant_lens" })).toBeNull()
  })

  it("renders nothing for a product that is not a bundle", () => {
    const { container } = renderSection({
      id: "prod_shirt",
      title: "Shirt",
      metadata: null,
    } as unknown as HttpTypes.AdminProduct)

    expect(container.firstChild).toBeNull()
  })
})
```

```bash
cd /Users/alexgrapsas/medusa-114 && cat > packages/admin/dashboard/src/routes/products/product-detail/components/product-bundle-section/product-bundle-section.tsx <<'EOF'
import { PencilSquare } from "@medusajs/icons"
import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
import { Container, Heading, Text } from "@medusajs/ui"
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next"
import { Link } from "react-router-dom"

import { ActionMenu } from "../../../../../components/common/action-menu"
import { useVariants } from "../../../../../hooks/api/product-variants"
import { getBundleComponents, isBundle } from "../../../common/bundles"

type ProductBundleSectionProps = {
  product: HttpTypes.AdminProduct
}

/**
 * Lists a bundle's components and their quantities on its product page
 * (issue #114, AC 5). It renders nothing for a product that is not a bundle.
 *
 * The components are stored as variant IDs, so the variants are read to get a
 * name and the product to link to. A component whose variant can't be read is
 * still listed by its ID: a bundle that looks like it has fewer parts than it
 * does would be worse than an unnamed row.
 */
export const ProductBundleSection = ({
  product,
}: ProductBundleSectionProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation()

  const components = getBundleComponents(product.metadata)

  const { variants = [] } = useVariants(
    {
      id: (components ?? []).map((component) => component.variant_id),
      fields: "id,title,product_id,product.title",
      limit: components?.length || 1,
    },
    { enabled: !!components?.length }
  )

  if (!isBundle(product) || !components) {
    return null
  }

  const variantsById = new Map(variants.map((variant) => [variant.id, variant]))

  return (
    <Container className="divide-y p-0">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4">
        <div>
          <Heading level="h2">{t("products.bundles.section.header")}</Heading>
          <Text size="small" className="text-ui-fg-subtle">
            {t("products.bundles.section.hint")}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <ActionMenu
          groups={[
            {
              actions: [
                {
                  label: t("products.bundles.editAction"),
                  to: "edit-bundle",
                  icon: <PencilSquare />,
                },
              ],
            },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      {components.map((component) => {
        const variant = variantsById.get(component.variant_id) as
          | (HttpTypes.AdminProductVariant & {
              product?: { id?: string; title?: string | null } | null
            })
          | undefined

        const name = variant
          ? [variant.product?.title, variant.title].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
          : t("products.bundles.section.unknownVariant", {
              id: component.variant_id,
            })

        const productId = variant?.product_id ?? variant?.product?.id

        return (
          <div
            key={component.variant_id}
            className="text-ui-fg-subtle flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4"
          >
            {productId ? (
              <Link
                to={`/products/${productId}`}
                className="text-ui-fg-interactive txt-small"
              >
                {name}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <Text size="small">{name}</Text>
            )}
            <Text size="small" className="tabular-nums">
              {t("products.bundles.section.quantity", {
                count: component.quantity,
              })}
            </Text>
          </div>
        )
      })}
    </Container>
  )
}
EOF
```
